_comment: Single source of truth for labels. Synced by .github/workflows/labels.yml and enforced by .github/workflows/ticket-status.yml. Only the repo owner and the bots listed in 'agents' may apply status labels. The owner can move tickets freely. Agents are limited to the transitions in each status's 'from' (null = no status yet) and can never apply a 'human_only' label.

status.name: needs-clarification
status.description: Ticket is ambiguous. Waiting on a human to answer questions.

status.name: ready-for-review
status.description: PR is open and checks pass. Waiting for human review.
